knowledge_point.title: Applying Row Operations To an Augmented Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $N,$ given by

$$
N=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}2 & 4 & -6 \\ 3 & -6 & -1 \\ 7 & 7 & -6\end{array}\right].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation $R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{3}$ on $N?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The operation $R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{3}$ means that we need to swap the first and third rows.

Applying this row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}N &= \left[\begin{array}{cc|c}2 & 4 & -6 \\ 3 & -6 & -1 \\ 7 & 7 & -6\end{array}\right]\,R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{3} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{cc|c}7 & 7 & -6 \\ 3 & -6 & -1 \\ 2 & 4 & -6\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $N,$ given by

$$
N=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}0 & -6 & 0 & 6 \\ 7 & -4 & -7 & 6 \\ -5 & -6 & 0 & 7\end{array}\right].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation $R_{1}:=-\frac{1}{2}R_{1}$ on $N?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The operation $R_{1}:=-\frac{1}{2}R_{1}$ means that we need to multiply the first row of the matrix by $-\frac{1}{2}.$

Multiplying the $1$st row by $-\frac{1}{2}$, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}N &= \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}0 & -6 & 0 & 6 \\ 7 & -4 & -7 & 6 \\ -5 & -6 & 0 & 7\end{array}\right]\,R_{1}:=-\frac{1}{2}R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-\frac{1}{2}\cdot 0 & -\frac{1}{2}\cdot (-6) & -\frac{1}{2}\cdot 0 & -\frac{1}{2}\cdot 6 \\ 7 & -4 & -7 & 6 \\ -5 & -6 & 0 & 7\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}0 & 3 & 0 & -3 \\ 7 & -4 & -7 & 6 \\ -5 & -6 & 0 & 7\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $N,$ given by

$$
N=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-6 & -1 & 7 \\ 7 & -6 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation $R_{1}:=R_{1}+(2)\cdot R_{2}$ on $N?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The operation $R_{1}:=R_{1}+(2)\cdot R_{2}$ means that we need to add $2$ times the second row to the first row.

Applying this row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}N &= \left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-6 & -1 & 7 \\ 7 & -6 & 2\end{array}\right]\,R_{1}:=R_{1}+(2)\cdot R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-6+(2)(7) & -1+(2)(-6) & 7+(2)(2) \\ 7 & -6 & 2\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{cc|c}8 & -13 & 11 \\ 7 & -6 & 2\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $T,$ given by

$$
T=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-1 & 5 & -1 & -3 \\ 3 & 0 & 9 & 5 \\ 3 & -4 & 4 & 1\end{array}\right].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on $T?$

$$
\begin{aligned}R_{1} &\leftrightarrow R_{3} \\ R_{2} &:=R_{2}+(-3)\cdot R_{3}\end{aligned}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let's list the required operations:

- The operation $R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{3}$ means that we need to swap the first and third rows.

- The operation $R_{2}:=R_{2}+(-3)\cdot R_{3}$ means that we need to add $-3$ times the third row to the second row.

Applying the operations, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}T &= \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-1 & 5 & -1 & -3 \\ 3 & 0 & 9 & 5 \\ 3 & -4 & 4 & 1\end{array}\right]\,R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{3} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}3 & -4 & 4 & 1 \\ 3 & 0 & 9 & 5 \\ -1 & 5 & -1 & -3\end{array}\right]\,R_{2}:=R_{2}+(-3)\cdot R_{3} \\ &\sim {\scriptsize \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}3 & -4 & 4 & 1 \\ 3+(-3)(-1) & 0+(-3)(5) & 9+(-3)(-1) & 5+(-3)(-3) \\ -1 & 5 & -1 & -3\end{array}\right]} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}3 & -4 & 4 & 1 \\ 6 & -15 & 12 & 14 \\ -1 & 5 & -1 & -3\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

$$
question.:question/worked-solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}T &= \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}4 & -2 & 0 & 0 \\ 6 & -5 & -6 & 0 \\ 7 & 1 & -2 & -1\end{array}\right]\,R_{1}:=-\frac{1}{2}R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-2 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 6 & -5 & -6 & 0 \\ 7 & 1 & -2 & -1\end{array}\right]\,R_{2}:=R_{2}+(-2)\cdot R_{1} \\ &\sim {\scriptsize \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-2 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 6+(-2)(-2) & -5+(-2)(1) & -6+(-2)(0) & 0+(-2)(0) \\ 7 & 1 & -2 & -1\end{array}\right]} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-2 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 10 & -7 & -6 & 0 \\ 7 & 1 & -2 & -1\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
